data.title: Jobcenter Musterlingen: Invitation to Appointment on 22.04.2026
data.summary: The Jobcenter Musterlingen (Team 311) invites Lea Muster to an in-person appointment (Meldeaufforderung under § 59 SGB II / § 309 SGB III) on Wednesday, 22.04.2026 at 08:15 in Room 1.18 with Frau Petzold, to discuss her current professional situation. She is asked to bring her CV.
data.explanation: This is an official summons (Meldeaufforderung) from your local Jobcenter to discuss your job-seeking situation. You must attend on the stated date and time and bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you cannot attend, contact the Jobcenter beforehand and explain the reason (an "important reason", wichtiger Grund) — for example illness with a doctor's note. If you miss the appointment without such a reason, the letter states your Bürgergeld (basic income support) will be cut by 10% of the standard rate for one month, so it's important not to skip it or to reschedule in time.
